title: Peel Apart
author: dawsonjones2020
rules:
I solved Bananalanced Chaocolates by ThePedallingPianist when it was first released over two years ago. I recently stumbled upon it again and started wondering how the ruleset might work on a 9x9 grid. This puzzle is my attempt at adapting it. It may not be quite as elegant as the original, but I hope it's still a fun solve!

Solve on SudokuPad

Rules

Chocolate Banana: Shade some cells such that orthogonally connected groups of shaded cells (chocolate bars) are square or rectangular, and orthogonally connected groups of unshaded cells (bananas) are not.

Chaos Construction: Find nine non-overlapping, orthogonally connected 9-cell regions such that any chocolate bar or banana is entirely contained within one single region. Fill every row, column, and region with the digits 1-9 once each.

Circles: A digit in a circle shows the total number of cells in that chocolate bar or banana. Additionally, the circles represent an extra region, i.e. they contain the digits 1-9 once each.

Non-Consecutive Bananas: Orthogonally adjacent digits in bananas must not be consecutive.

Arrows: Digits along an arrow sum to the digit in the attached circle.

White Kropki Dots: Digits connected by a white dot are consecutive.
